name: staleproof
description: Staleproof keeps docs and AI agent files true to the code. After each edit Claude hears which docs it made wrong; before it stops, it is asked to fix them.

plugins.name: staleproof
plugins.description: Docs and agent files (README, docs, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) checked against Claude's edits: hooks after each edit and before stopping, a skill, /staleproof:check, fix, audit and docs-for. Local; nothing leaves the machine.
